notes: Lead source: inbound — signed up for free credits via marketing microsite; experimenting with hosted API.
Company background: mid-size ecommerce SaaS that provides merchant storefront customizations and support bots.
Primary POC: chat-based merchant support + automated order lookup (doc-search + reranking for receipts).
Current prototype: thin backend that hits hosted API per chat turn, no batching, full-order history in context (~2.5k tokens per request).
Cost sensitivity: CTO Asha Patel — 'We can scale to customers only if unit cost < $0.02/conversation on average' — wants concrete levers.
Performance targets: p95 response latency target 250ms (acceptable up to 400ms for complex queries); peak QPS expected 3-6 during business hours.
Ask summary from discovery: thorough token usage audit of their message flows; recommendations for batching and prefix/KV caching; help with prompt compression and template refactor.
Technical constraints: public cloud preferred (AWS us-east), no private deployment for now; must integrate with existing SSO (SAML).
Security: needs audit logging; asked if Redwood exposes request/response logs for 30-day retention (not storing PII by default).
SE notes from Priya: sampled 20 conversations — median tokens/request 1.8k, top-10 heavy templates contain large product catalogs in-line — ripe for compression or embedding lookup.

Immediate recommendations shared: switch to streaming small responses, implement request-side batching for order lookups (combine multiple user prompts into multi-turn batch where possible), extract product metadata into embeddings + vector lookup to replace large context blobs.
Commercial: interested in hosted API usage tier; initial ARR estimate low ($1k-$10k). Wants pricing transparency on per-token and per-embedding to model monthly bill.
Quote from CTO on call: 'We need an audit we can plug into our sprint — show us where the spend is and 3 quick wins we can implement this sprint.'
Internal ask: prepare a one-pager 'Token Audit + Quick Wins' and a sample script that scans logs and outputs top-10 expensive prompts by token cost (Priya to own).
Other: potential to expand to Dedicated if they outgrow self-serve and need predictable throughput in 9-12 months — flag as expansion opportunity.
